sequence.description: Joc Pederson singles on a ground ball to third baseman Isaac Paredes.
Wyatt Langford called out on strikes.
Corey Seager singles on a ground ball to right fielder Cam Smith. Joc Pederson to 2nd.
Brandon Nimmo flies out to left fielder LaMonte Wade Jr.
Evan Carter flies out to shortstop Jeremy Peña.
Yordan Alvarez grounds out, pitcher Jacob deGrom to first baseman Joc Pederson.
Isaac Paredes singles on a line drive to center fielder Evan Carter.
Christian Walker grounds out, second baseman Nicky Lopez to first baseman Joc Pederson.
